summary.en: Israeli forces are expanding operations in southern Syria, threatening new territory in Syria, Lebanon and Gaza, while a Syrian security officer was killed in a coastal attack and another patrol attack in western Syria wounded four. Syrian Christian leaders condemned recent attacks on their community, and a Syrian security officer was killed on the coast. The UN deputy relief chief warned that Syrians cannot afford more instability. The UCDP recorded 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israelske styrker utvider operasjoner i sørlige Syria, og truer nytt territorium i Syria, Libanon og Gaza, mens en syrisk sikkerhetsoffiser ble drept i et kystangrep og et annet patruljeangrep i vestlige Syria såret fire. Syriske kristne ledere fordømte nylige angrep på deres samfunn, og en syrisk sikkerhetsoffiser ble drept på kysten. FNs nestleder for nødhjelp advarte om at syrere ikke har råd til mer ustabilitet. UCDP registrerte 2 732 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
